results.criterion: Starting from the V4 launcher, the signed-in user opens GIS, loads an available Surveyor layer, and the layer legend displays a `Display Settings` control.
steps_taken: Navigated to the V4 launcher and confirmed the signed-in welcome screen.
Opened GIS, selected the available Surveyor layer with its default Service configuration, and added it to the map.
Observed the Surveyor - Service legend with the Display Settings control.
Removed the added layer to restore the map.

results.criterion: After opening `Display Settings`, the panel displays a `Show linked sites` control with a discernible current state.
steps_taken: Returned to the V4 launcher, opened GIS, and added the available Surveyor layer using its default configuration.
Opened Display Settings and observed Show linked sites checked.
Removed the added layer to restore the map.

results.criterion: After changing `Show linked sites` to the opposite state, the control visibly displays the new state.
steps_taken: Returned to the V4 launcher, opened GIS, and added the available Surveyor layer using its default configuration.
Opened Display Settings and observed Show linked sites initially checked.
Clicked Show linked sites once and observed that it was unchecked.
Restored Show linked sites to checked and removed the added layer.

results.criterion: After restoring `Show linked sites` to its original state, closing and reopening `Display Settings` shows the original state again.
steps_taken: Returned to the V4 launcher, opened GIS, and added the available Surveyor layer using its default configuration.
Opened Display Settings and observed Show linked sites checked.
Closed Display Settings, reopened it, and observed Show linked sites remained checked.
Removed the added layer to restore the map.

## TEST2-48 QA Test

All four acceptance criteria passed in V4 GIS. The Surveyor legend displayed Display Settings; Show linked sites was initially on, changed visibly to off, restored to on, and remained on after closing and reopening Display Settings.
